name: WS2812B
notes: The generic 800 kbps RGB pixel of most 5 V strips. Older WS2812B datasheets give a reset above 50 µs; the Mar-2017 one gives above 300 µs, and the longer figure is kept.

bit_s.src: DS-WS2812B p. 4, TH+TL = 1.25 µs ± 600 ns, Worldsemi WS2812B Specifications, Mar-2017, https://www.triopak.fi/files/product/Worldsemi/WS2812B.pdf

bits_per_channel.src: DS-WS2812B p. 5, 24 bits per pixel in G, R, B order, Worldsemi WS2812B Specifications, Mar-2017, https://www.triopak.fi/files/product/Worldsemi/WS2812B.pdf

reset_s.src: DS-WS2812B p. 4, RES low time above 300 µs, Worldsemi WS2812B Specifications, Mar-2017, https://www.triopak.fi/files/product/Worldsemi/WS2812B.pdf
